verdict.rationale: Zero's only agent-facing surface is the MCP server. Its documented authentication is a full Better Auth session token copied from browser cookies, with OAuth marked 'coming soon'. Nothing documents issuing scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API credentials, and an unscoped session cookie is the opposite of least privilege.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
